name: Speed up a slow Persian WordPress site without guessing
query: سایت وردپرس فارسی‌ام روی موبایل خیلی کند است و متن موقع لود می‌پرد. مخاطبم داخل ایران است و روی هاست اشتراکی هستم. سریعش کن.
expected_behavior: Step 1: Run scripts/speed_audit.mjs with --root and --url before proposing any change
Step 2: Establish a baseline per references/measurement.md: TTFB uncached, cached, and logged-in, each with conditions recorded
Step 3: Start with fonts — audit payload, subset with --layout-features preserved, convert to woff2, cap at two weights
Step 4: Fix CLS with a size-adjust fallback @font-face rather than only font-display: swap
Step 5: Self-host fonts instead of a foreign CDN, given the Iranian audience
Step 6: Verify the cache actually HITs before recommending another caching plugin
Step 7: Check autoload size and unbounded queries for the logged-in TTFB
Step 8: Only after 1-7, discuss hosting/CDN, and ask about audience location before recommending a foreign CDN
Step 9: Record before/after numbers in a baseline file
success_criteria: No change is recommended without a recorded before-number
Font payload is brought to 150 KB or less, woff2 only, at most two weights
pyftsubset keeps --layout-features='*' so Persian letters still join
Exactly one font is preloaded, with crossorigin
CLS fix uses metric overrides, not just font-display
Cache HIT/MISS is verified with response headers before blaming the plugin
A foreign CDN is not recommended for an Iran-only audience without discussion
Risky minify/combine/defer flags are enabled one at a time with RTL layout re-tested
A database backup precedes autoload or revision cleanup
speed_audit.mjs exits 0 and before/after numbers are reported with conditions
